ISCI 300.title: Interdisciplinary Seminar
ISCI 300.description: Critical analysis of recent scientific literature that combines disciplines that students are integrating in their Integrated Sciences Curriculum. .

prerequisite.raw: Registration in Integrated Sciences Program

ISCI 311.title: The Size of Things
ISCI 311.description: Scaling as a general approach to laws governing the geometry, kinematics and dynamics of systems. Dimensional analysis, isometry and allometry applied to topics from Biology, Physics, Earth Science and Economics. Priority to students in the Integrated Sciences Program.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 311.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 312.title: Symmetry
ISCI 312.description: Recognizing symmetry; point groups in 2D and 3D; plane groups in 2D; space groups in 3D; the role of symmetry in the natural and human world.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 312.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 320.title: Research Development Project
ISCI 320.description: Retreat to develop skills in writing scientific research proposals. Emphasis on formulating and testing hypotheses to explain observations. Course location will vary; fee payable prior to retreat.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 320.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 322.title: Science of Measurement and Instrumentation
ISCI 322.description: Interactive course integrating diverse aspects of science: semi-quantitative overview of physical principles underlying modern measurement technology; philosophy of measurement; accuracy and limits to measurement, and resultant scientific, sociological and economic consequences. Priority to students in the Integrated Sciences Program.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 322.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 330.title: Topics in Integrated Sciences
ISCI 330.description: Interactive examination of a theme common to all areas of science. Themes will change from year to year. Priority to students in the Integrated Sciences Program.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 330.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 344.title: Theory and Practice of Games in Economics and Evolution
ISCI 344.description: Exploration of human and animal interactions: integrating evolutionary and economic perspectives to investigate individual and social behaviour.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing

ISCI 345.title: Integrative Bioinformatics
ISCI 345.description: Storage and processing of information in biological systems. Computational methods for recovering and interpreting stored genetic information. Priority to students in the Integrated Sciences Program.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 345.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 350.title: Darwinian Medicine
ISCI 350.description: Using the Darwinian theory of natural selection to explore explanations of infectious diseases, allergies, cancer, mental illness, and other human diseases. Priority to students in the Integrated Sciences Program. Please consult the Faculty of Science Credit Exclusion Lists: www.vancouver.calendar.ubc.ca/faculties-colleges-and-schools/faculty-science/bachelor-science/credit-exclusion-lists

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 350.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 351.title: Why the Big Brain? The Evolution of Human Cognition
ISCI 351.description: Evolutionary causes, consequences and constraints of human cognition; enhanced encephalization and mentalizing capabilities throughout the Primate Order, and the emergence of cognitive faculties that define the human species.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year or higher standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 351.prerequisiteText: Third-year or higher standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 360.title: Systems Approaches to Regional Sustainability
ISCI 360.description: Application of systems science encompassing geological, hydrological, ecological, atmospheric sciences, and energy systems approaches to study regional sustainability.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year or higher standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 360.prerequisiteText: Third-year or higher standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 361.title: Field Course: Systems Approaches to Regional Sustainability
ISCI 361.description: Systems science approaches encompassing geological, hydrological, ecological, atmospheric sciences, and energy systems to investigate a selected region of the world. Course location will vary; fee payable prior to field course.

ISCI 398.title: Co-operative Work Placement I
ISCI 398.description: Industrial or academic work experience for a minimum of 4 months. Normally taken in Winter Session of third year or Summer Session after third year. Technical report required. Restricted to students in the ISP Co-op program.

prerequisite.raw: One term in ISP

ISCI 399.title: Co-operative Work Placement II
ISCI 399.description: Industrial or academic work experience for a minimum of 4 months. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to the Co-op Program in ISP.

prerequisite.raw: ISCI 398

ISCI 400.title: Integrated Sciences Graduating Seminar
ISCI 400.description: Reflection of Integrated Sciences degree experience, development of professional skills, and a showcase of degree integrations to the community. Pass/Fail.

prerequisite.raw: Fourth-year standing in the Integrated Sciences specialization

ISCI 400.prerequisiteText: Fourth-year standing in the Integrated Sciences specialization

ISCI 422.title: Models in Science
ISCI 422.description: Meaning, nature, use, strengths and limitations of models as investigative tools in all scientific disciplines. Detailed investigation of selected model systems from different scientific disciplines. Priority to students in the Integrated Sciences Program.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 422.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 433.title: Ethical Issues in Science
ISCI 433.description: Theoretical and practical consideration of ethics in the practice, reporting, public impact and accountability of science.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in any faculty

ISCI 434.title: Non-Animal Methods in Biomedical Science
ISCI 434.description: Interdisciplinary non-animal methods (e.g., organoids, organ-on-a-chip, 3D bioprinting) for research, testing, and education; the regulatory landscape.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing

ISCI 448.title: Directed Studies
ISCI 448.description: Permission of the Director is required.

ISCI 449.title: Interdisciplinary Honours Thesis
ISCI 449.description: Original research work under the guidance of a faculty member. Registration by approval of the Integrated Sciences Director.

ISCI 461.title: Comparative Field Research Course: Systems Approaches to Regional Sustainability
ISCI 461.description: Systems science approaches encompassing geological, hydrological, ecological, atmospheric sciences, and energy systems to investigate, analyze and research two unique regions of the world. Course location may vary; course location must be different than ISCI 361; fee payable prior to field course.

prerequisite.raw: ISCI 361

ISCI 490.title: Student Directed Seminars
ISCI 490.description: Self-directed, collaborative studies, in a group-learning environment, initiated and coordinated by senior undergraduate students with the supervision of a faculty advisor. Course structure, enrolment and delivery methods will comply with the Handbook for Student Directed Seminars.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 490.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing in the Faculty of Science

ISCI 498.title: Co-operative Work Placement III
ISCI 498.description: Industrial or academic work experience for a minimum of 4 months. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to the Co-op Program in ISP.

prerequisite.raw: ISCI 399

ISCI 499.title: Co-Operative Work Placement IV
ISCI 499.description: Industrial or academic work experience for a minimum of 4 months. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to the Co-op Program in ISP.

prerequisite.raw: ISCI 498
